profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Developer with experience developing solutions for a number of government programs.
Proficient with the latest development and design methodologies. 
Certified Java Programmer

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Primary developer for a system that provides content management and workflow capabilities for Analysts who clear and declassify documents.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and built a wiki application that enabled 200 Intelligence Analysts to collaborate and jointly develop Intelligence products.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of development team creating search, analysis, and collaboration tools to support Intelligence Analysts.  These tools included a custom federated search application with visualization and analysis capabilities, and a document search, view, and vetting application.

positions.title: Software Generalist
positions.description: Responsible for a variety of tasks to support the National Cancer Institute client, including requirements, testing, documentation, code, and graphics.

positions.title: XML Developer
positions.description: Part of the Grants.gov form development team - developing XML-based forms, schemas, XSL stylesheets, and XSL-FO (formatting objects for PDF export).
